prompts.prompt: Use case: game sprite atlas. Create exactly SIXTEEN full-body 2D illustrated zombie animation frames in a strict 4 column by 4 row equal-cell grid on a truly transparent square background. Art style reference is image 1: hand-painted fighting game sprites with detailed torn clothing, pale undead skin, hunched shambling posture and crisp dark outlines, NOT 3D. Clothing/flag references specify costume only. Character: yellow Brazil T-shirt with green BRASIL text and small Brazilian flag, ripped jeans. Fictional zombie with receding gray hair holding a small revolver, slow aiming and recoil poses; no flying bullets in sprite atlas. All poses face RIGHT, consistent identity, costume and body scale, separate full silhouettes with generous transparent gutters; do not touch cell edges or adjacent poses. Ordered frames left to right row by row: row1 idle, walk left foot planted, walk dragging foot, walk right foot planted. row2 entering hunched low, attack1 windup, attack1 contact, attack1 recovery. row3 attack2 windup, attack2 contact, attack3 windup, attack3 contact. row4 hit reaction leaning backward, dead lying on ground, jump knees bent, falling legs extended. For unarmed types use three different claw swipes; flag types use pole swings; revolver use aiming then firing recoil. Whole character including weapons fits each cell. Same feet baseline within standing frames. No background, no ground shadows, no captions, no UI, no watermarks. Keep death sprite smaller in height at same body scale. Weapon must stay connected to hands.
